commands: {{#if (includes (lookupArray upgrades 'depName') 'vite-plus')}}pnpm dlx --package=vite-plus@{{#each upgrades}}{{#if (equals depName 'vite-plus')}}{{{newVersion}}}{{/if}}{{/each}} vp migrate --no-interactive{{else}}pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts{{/if}}

prBodyNotes: Vite Plus upgrades run the selected release's official `vp migrate --no-interactive` before installing new project dependencies. Review the generated source/configuration changes and any manual migration findings in the Renovate logs.

packageRules.description: The official Vite Plus migrator owns bundled Vite/Vitest versions; independently released plugins remain eligible for updates
Historical Schemars contracts and probe helper dependencies are immutable audit inputs
Every Schemars release requires an explicit era review and an @correctlyjs/schemars release
prBodyNotes: The Schemars contract check must fail on this initial dependency update, even if schemas are unchanged. Identical output requires extending the current era; changed output requires a new era beginning at this release. Preserve every historical pin/fixture, add behavioral coverage and a new @correctlyjs/schemars changeset naming this Schemars version.

CI prevents skipping stable releases. If Renovate proposes a later patch or stream, review and release the intervening versions first. Every reviewed Schemars release requires its own published @correctlyjs/schemars version.
